news.headline: Delcath Systems Sets Second Quarter 2026 Earnings Call for August 6
news.summary: Delcath confirmed it will host its Q2 2026 earnings conference call on Thursday, August 6, 2026 at 8:30 AM Eastern to discuss results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. It will be the company's next major catalyst after a Q1 2026 beat and reiterated full-year revenue guidance of at least $100 million.

news.headline: Delcath Systems Announces Inducement Grants Under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4)
news.summary: Delcath granted 17,000 restricted stock units, effective July 1, 2026, as employment inducements under its 2023 Inducement Plan to four new employees who joined in May and June 2026. The routine Nasdaq-required disclosure points to continued headcount additions as the company scales its commercial and clinical operations.

news.headline: BTIG Raises Delcath Systems Price Target to $17 from $16, Maintains Buy
news.summary: BTIG analyst Marie Thibault raised her price target on Delcath Systems to $17 from $16 while reiterating a Buy rating. The modest increase reflects continued confidence in HEPZATO KIT's commercial trajectory following the company's Q1 2026 print and reiterated full-year revenue guidance.

news.headline: Zacks Research Upgrades Delcath Systems to Hold from Strong Sell
news.summary: Zacks Research raised its rating on Delcath Systems from 'strong sell' to 'hold', with the stock trading near $13 that day. Across covering sell-side analysts the stock carries a Strong Buy / Moderate Buy consensus with an average price target in the low-to-mid $20s.

news.headline: Delcath Systems Announces First Patient Dosed in Phase 2 Trial of HEPZATO in Liver-Dominant Metastatic Breast Cancer
news.summary: Delcath dosed the first patient, at the European Institute of Oncology in Milan, in its global randomized Phase 2 DELUMA trial (NCT06875128) testing HEPZATO plus standard of care versus standard of care alone in liver-dominant HER2-negative metastatic breast cancer. The roughly 90-patient trial is planned to run at more than 20 sites across the US and Europe.

news.headline: Delcath Systems Shares Trade Near $12.50 as Institutional Ownership Holds Around 49%
news.summary: Delcath shares traded around $12.49 in late June 2026, with roughly 49% of outstanding shares held by 126 institutional owners including BlackRock, Vanguard, Geode Capital, and Rosalind Advisors. The steady institutional base reflects continued Street interest in the HEPZATO KIT commercial ramp ahead of Q2 results.

catalysts.label: Q2 2026 earnings call
catalysts.detail: Formally confirmed on July 23, 2026. Management is expected to update HEPZATO volume growth, site-activation pace, and progress toward the $100M+ FY2026 revenue guidance after a Q1 2026 beat.

catalysts.label: Full-year 2026 revenue guidance of at least $100 million
catalysts.detail: Reiterated on the Q1 2026 call (May 7, 2026), implying continued double-digit growth in HEPZATO KIT volume over 2025's revenue base; delivery against this target is the key near-term proof point ahead of Q2 results.

catalysts.label: HEPZATO active treatment center expansion toward ~37-40 sites
catalysts.detail: Management has guided to continued expansion of active US HEPZATO centers through 2026 and into 2027, a key driver of continued volume growth; new centers were activated in Q1 2026 and headcount additions (per the July 16 inducement grant filing) point to ongoing scale-up.

catalysts.when: Ongoing, enrollment 2026-2028; primary endpoint end of 2028
catalysts.label: Phase 2 DELUMA trial in liver-dominant metastatic breast cancer
catalysts.detail: First patient was dosed July 9, 2026 in the ~90-patient randomized trial (NCT06875128) of HEPZATO plus standard of care vs. standard of care alone, across 20+ US/European sites. Primary endpoint (hepatic progression-free survival) is anticipated by end of 2028, with overall survival data expected in 2029.

catalysts.label: Phase 2 trial in liver-dominant metastatic colorectal cancer
catalysts.detail: Randomized ~90-patient study of HEPZATO plus trifluridine-tipiracil/bevacizumab vs. that regimen alone in third-line colorectal cancer patients, with site activation ongoing across a planned ~26 centers. Hepatic progression-free survival data is anticipated around mid-2028, with overall survival data expected in late 2028.

pulse: News flow on Delcath over the past six weeks has been light but steadily positive: the July 9 dosing of the first patient in the new Phase 2 DELUMA trial (HEPZATO in liver-dominant metastatic breast cancer) extends the pipeline beyond uveal melanoma and colorectal cancer, while Wall Street sentiment has firmed, with Zacks upgrading the stock to Hold and BTIG raising its price target to $17 in mid-July against a Street consensus in the low-to-mid $20s. A routine inducement-grant filing on July 16 also signals the company is still adding headcount as it scales commercial operations, and institutional ownership has held steady near 49% of shares outstanding. The next real catalyst is Q2 2026 earnings, confirmed for August 6, 2026, where investors will look for continued HEPZATO volume growth, further site-activation progress, and confirmation the company stays on track for its $100M+ full-year revenue guidance.
